repos_data.description: 🛡️ Free AI that blocks hackers while you sleep. Runs on cheap hardware. When someone in Tokyo gets attacked, you're protected in 30 seconds. No fees. No experts needed. Just protection. One node's detection → everyone's protection.

BomLens — a local-first SBOM generator & open-source risk assessor (CycloneDX). Produce an SBOM, an open-source notice, and a security/license risk report from source code, containers, binaries, firmware, or an SBOM you received. CLI or web UI, no SaaS.
